The '''RD-15A Mercenary''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that was used by it's creators the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian warrior clans]] or that of elite [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. The RD-15A along with it's similar counterparts the [[Mercenary Elite Prototype Armor]], [[TH-15A Corpsman]], [[TT-15A Powertech]], and the [[Mandalorian Enforcer armor]] all still remained in use during the [[war against Zakuul]].
